text: ∀x (Tsunami(x) → (∃y (UnderwaterEarthquake(y) ∧ Triggers(y, x)) ∨ ∃z (VolcanicEruption(z) ∧ Triggers(z, x)) ∨ ∃w (Landslide(w) ∧ Triggers(w, x)))) ::: A tsunami can be triggered by underwater earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, or landslides, causing a series of massive waves that devastate coastal areas.
